items.review_rationale: Reviewed closed-set finite-intersection-property characterization of compactness, including nonempty intersection of each finite selection and total intersection conclusion.

references.phrase: compact topological space via open covers

references.context: Every finite subfamily has a nonempty intersection, including all finite subcollections.
Intersection of all closed sets in the entire family contains at least one point.

references.disposition: Complementation of covers gives the equivalent criterion with no Hausdorff assumption.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed eigenvector for specified eigenvalue of field-linear operator as a nonzero vector obeying the eigen equation.

references.phrase: field K and vector space V

references.context: Linear endomorphism of K-vector space V.
Vector distinct from zero satisfying A(v)=lambda*v.

references.disposition: The eigen equation must use the specified eigenvalue lambda rather than an arbitrary scalar.

items.review_rationale: Reviewed kernel formulation of eigenvector with v≠0 and v in kernel(A−lambda I), using the same operator and scalar context.

references.context: Vector different from zero lying in kernel of shifted endomorphism.
Linear map w↦A(w)−lambda*w for identity map I_V.

references.disposition: A(v)=lambda*v iff (A−lambda I)(v)=0; zero vector excluded.
